name: ditter
description: 운영 중인 PostgreSQL에 붙는 읽기 전용 웹 SQL 콘솔

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
